title: Reduce SDK startup allocations and orchestrate dependency bump wave across Python/JS/Go
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Multiple SDKs (Python, JS, Go) show increased cold-start memory and CPU due to layered transport adapters, legacy response wrappers and unpinned transitive deps. This causes higher tail latency for bursty requests and complicates private deployment images. Scope: 1) Bump core transport and crypto deps in each language to their vetted LTS patch (see attachments for matrix). 2) Remove legacy response wrapper abstraction in favor of unified typed responses to shave allocations. 3) Replace synchronous I/O fallbacks with async primitives (Python/JS) and reduce startup allocations in Go by lazy-initing large caches. 4) API surface cleanup: mark old "response_wrapper" and "legacy_retry" params as deprecated and add migration warnings in logs. Acceptance criteria: - All three language clients build cleanly and pass unit+integration suites. - End-to-end latency p95 for cold-start scenarios reduced by >=20% in microbenchmarks. - No production API contract changes (only deprecations); SDKs log deprecation warnings when legacy fields used. - CI gates enforce no new transitive deps without owner approval. Rollout plan: - Create per-language branch that applies dep bumps + code changes. - Run language-specific performance harnesses in canary infra. - Publish staged alpha packages for internal partners and collect feedback for 48h. - Coordinate hosted runtime and console owners for any telemetry schema changes. Migration plan: - Add detailed migration notes in release notes and a short script for teams that still use legacy wrappers. - Keep legacy shim compiled but gated behind runtime flag for two release cycles. Risks & mitigations: - Risk: bumped cryptography transitive surface could trigger CVE scanners. Mitigation: pre-scan with SCA tools and freeze bump if high-risk. - Risk: small behavioral differences in retry semantics. Mitigation: run synthetic replay of customer traces and compare outputs. Tasks: - Python: async refactor + bump aiohttp/cryptography (ENG-764322) - JS: remove legacy wrapper + switch to fetch-based transport (ENG-764323) - Go: lazy init caches + bump net/http helper libs (ENG-764324) - CI: add performance benchmark job and transitive dep approval step (ENG-764325)
